mapper.select: SELECT id, title, subtitle, link, today_challenge, published_at, created_at FROM news_articles ORDER BY published_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO news_articles (title, subtitle, link, today_challenge, published_at, created_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{subtitle}, #{link}, #{todayChallenge}, #{publishedAt}, #{createdAt})
